title: Let the Speedrun Search Itself
summary: Eval-gated autoresearch receipts for the canonical super fp8 speedrun lane. This package captures the raw campaign receipts, champion progression, NVIZ-backed run summaries, and the config/worker surfaces that define the bounded controller.
repro_commands: python -m nmoe.cli.main campaign auto speedrun_super_research --stage benchmark --max-trials 8
provenance_commands: python -m nmoe.cli.main campaign auto speedrun_super_research --stage benchmark --receipt-dir campaign_runs --max-trials 1
commands: python -m nmoe.cli.main campaign auto speedrun_super_research --stage benchmark --max-trials 8
notes: This campaign is intentionally config-only: the controller can only mutate allowlisted TOML/config keys and must reuse the canonical nmoe runner.

REPRO: repro_commands run the full campaign from a fresh clone on one 8-GPU machine. The search logic, eval gate, and receipt system are identical to the original run. Candidates run sequentially instead of in parallel.

PROVENANCE: provenance_commands document how the original result was produced: 4 parallel GPU workers with shared receipt storage, kubectl-managed cluster fanout, and NVIZ-backed artifact export. These are not required for reproduction.

blog_artifacts/0011_autoresearch_progression.json records only global champion updates; parallel waves may contain additional locally kept candidates that improved against an older shared baseline but were not the final champion.
blog_artifacts/0011_autoresearch_receipts.json retains failed and vetoed candidates so negative results remain machine-readable.
research-aux_loss_alpha-0.00018 achieved the best raw validation loss in the final refinement wave, but was vetoed because CORE fell past the allowed 0.002 drop budget.
The final champion is research-aux_loss_alpha-0.00012 with lr_dense=0.0022: final_valid_loss=5.119999885559082, CORE=-0.013624577546898952, and throughput/tokens_per_s_gpu=100724.1893794376.
